questions.question: On this day in 1942, Mutesa II was crowned as the 35th monarch of which historic African kingdom?
questions.explanation: Mutesa II became the 35th Kabaka of the Kingdom of Buganda on 19 November 1942.
questions.context:
On this day in 1942: Mutesa II is crowned the 35th and last Kabaka (king) of Buganda, prior to the restoration of the kingdom in 1993.
Mutesa II of Buganda (Monarch of the Kingdom of Buganda from 1939 to 1969): Edward Frederick William David Walugembe Mutebi Luwangula Mutesa II was a Ugandan royal and statesman who served as the first president of Uganda from 1962 to 1966, when he was overthrown by Milton Obote.

questions.question: Which character did Robert Downey Jr. sign on to portray as the lead antagonist in Marvel's Avengers: Doomsday?
questions.explanation: Avengers: Doomsday features Robert Downey Jr. leading the ensemble cast in the role of Doctor Doom.
questions.context: Avengers: Doomsday (Upcoming Marvel Studios film): Avengers: Doomsday is an upcoming American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics superhero team the Avengers. Produced by Marvel Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is intended to be the sequel to Avengers: Endgame (2019) and the 39th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, and written by Stephen McFeely and Michael Waldron, the film features an ensemble cast led by Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom.

questions.question: Which singer and actress achieved a top-ten Billboard Hot 100 hit with the single "Daydreamin'" from her 1998 debut album Kiss the Sky?
questions.explanation: Tatyana Ali released her gold-certified debut album Kiss the Sky in 1998, featuring the hit track "Daydreamin'".
questions.context: Tatyana Ali (American actress and singer (born 1979)): Tatyana Marisol Ali is an American actress and singer. She began her career as a child actress, appearing on the PBS television program Sesame Street. She rose to prominence with her role as Ashley Banks on the NBC sitcom The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air from 1990 to 1996. Her debut album Kiss the Sky (1998), was certified gold by the Recording Industry Association of America, and spawned the hit single "Daydreamin'", which peaked in the top ten of the Billboard Hot 100.

questions.question: Which criminal duo serves as the central protagonists in the open-world video game Grand Theft Auto VI?
options: Michael De Santa and Trevor Philips
questions.explanation: In Grand Theft Auto VI, the narrative follows criminal partners Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos through the state of Leonida.
questions.context: Grand Theft Auto VI (2026 video game): Grand Theft Auto VI is an action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games. It is the eighth main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, following 2013's Grand Theft Auto V, and the sixteenth entry overall. Set within the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida, and in the fictional city of Vice City, based on Miami, the story follows the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Players are able to freely roam Leonida's open world.

questions.question: Which television personality and season nineteen winner served as the host for season 35 of Dancing with the Stars alongside Julianne Hough?
questions.explanation: Former Dancing with the Stars winner Alfonso Ribeiro returned to host the show's 35th season with co-host Julianne Hough.
questions.context: Dancing with the Stars (American TV series) season 35: Season thirty-five of Dancing with the Stars premiered on ABC and Disney+ on September 15, 2026, and is scheduled to conclude on November 24, 2026. This season was the fourth to air live on both networks simultaneously. Season nineteen champion Alfonso Ribeiro returned to host the installment, while former professional dancer and judge Julianne Hough returned as co-host. A holiday television special will air following the season finale.
